messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-27; the earlier handover note of 2025-06-11 saying Cinder took ownership was written against the wrong team, and Cinder never owned it. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by Cinder as of 2025-06-11, having moved from the Boreal team. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- On 2025-11-03 the Boreal team noticed that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03-2]
- As of 2025-04-07, the Ember team reported that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-04-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-07]
- The notifier's flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- On 2025-03-26 the Dune team observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-03-26 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-26]
- Following the INC-2025-017 review, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed as of the 2025-11-24 handover. [valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
- On 2026-04-14 the Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
- On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the authentication gateway about the error rate. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- On 2026-05-27 the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- During incident INC-2026-009, the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team flagged the job scheduler's cold start regression because the job scheduler is not their service. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2]
- On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- On 2026-05-28 the Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff. [decision; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-03. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3]
- As of 2025-12-05, the pager for the reporting service rings the Ember team instead of the Dune team. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]

Question: Who was responsible for the notifier on 2025-05-17?

message.reasoning:
The question asks who was responsible for the notifier on 2025-05-17.

Looking at the ownership history:
- Boreal team owns the notifier: valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11
- Cinder as of 2025-06-11: valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27
- Dune team as of 2025-06-27: valid 2025-06-27 to now, with a correction note that Cinder never owned it (but that correction is dated 2025-06-27, so at 2025-05-17 the effective record at that time... The rules say a later entry supersedes an earlier one on the same subject. The correction says Cinder never owned it, meaning the 2025-06-11 note was wrong. So the Boreal ownership valid to 2025-06-11, then it would be Dune from 2025-06-27? But 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27 gap... Anyway, 2025-05-17 falls within Boreal's validity period (2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11).

Answer: Boreal team.
